name: Refresh Analytics
topic: WITH stats AS (     SELECT         sensor_id,         sensor_type,         ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS average,         ROUND(MIN(value), 2) AS minimum,         ROUND(MAX(value), 2) AS maximum,         COUNT(*) AS readings     FROM sensor_readings     WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%s','now') - 1800     GROUP BY sensor_id, sensor_type ),  latest AS (     SELECT         s.sensor_id,         s.value AS current     FROM sensor_readings s     INNER JOIN (         SELECT sensor_id, MAX(id) AS max_id         FROM sensor_readings         GROUP BY sensor_id     ) x ON s.id = x.max_id ),  recent AS (     SELECT         sensor_id,         AVG(value) AS recent_avg     FROM sensor_readings     WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%s','now') - 600     GROUP BY sensor_id ),  previous AS (     SELECT         sensor_id,         AVG(value) AS previous_avg     FROM sensor_readings     WHERE timestamp >= strftime('%s','now') - 1200       AND timestamp < strftime('%s','now') - 600     GROUP BY sensor_id )  SELECT     stats.sensor_id,     stats.sensor_type,     latest.current,     stats.average,     stats.minimum,     stats.maximum,     stats.readings,     ROUND(recent.recent_avg - previous.previous_avg, 2) AS change_10m FROM stats LEFT JOIN latest     ON stats.sensor_id = latest.sensor_id LEFT JOIN recent     ON stats.sensor_id = recent.sensor_id LEFT JOIN previous     ON stats.sensor_id = previous.sensor_id;

func:
const type = msg.payload?.type || msg.topic;

if (type !== "open_logbook") {
    return null;
}

msg.topic = `
SELECT
    'SECURITY' AS category,
    event_id AS record_id,
    sensor_id,
    event_type AS description,
    integrity AS status,
    timestamp AS event_time
FROM security_event_logs

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'OUTAGE' AS category,
    outage_id AS record_id,
    sensor_id,
    reason AS description,
    status,
    started_at AS event_time
FROM sensor_outage_logs

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'MAINTENANCE' AS category,
    ticket_id AS record_id,
    sensor_id,
    issue AS description,
    ticket_status AS status,
    created_at AS event_time
FROM maintenance_tickets

ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100;
`;

return msg;
